units.source_text: 我应该在那年的六月毕业，按规定，必须在四月底之前完成这篇论文。

en.t: I was supposed to graduate that June, and by the rules I had to finish this thesis before the end of April.

units.source_text: 二、三、四，我屈指算了算余下的时间，不禁有些怀疑自己的胆量。

en.t: Counting off February, March, and April on my fingers, I calculated the time left and could not help doubting my own nerve.

units.source_text: 别的同学很早就开始搜集资料，整理归纳笔记了，看上去都忙得不行，唯独我还没有着手。

en.t: The other students had begun gathering materials and organizing notes long before; they all looked terribly busy, while I alone had not yet started.

units.source_text: 我只是打算过了年就开始大干一场。

en.t: I had merely planned to throw myself into the work after New Year.

units.source_text: 出于这个决心着手写起来，但是很快就写不下去了。

en.t: With that resolve I began writing, but before long I could go no further.

units.source_text: 仅仅凭空设想了一个大题目，构思了粗略轮廓的我，现在开始着急了。

en.t: Having merely imagined a grand topic out of thin air and sketched a rough outline, I now began to panic.

units.source_text: 后来我决定把论文的题目缩小，

en.t: After that I decided to narrow the subject of my thesis,

units.source_text: 而且为了省去系统归纳自己见解的时间，我准备只罗列书中现成的资料，再适当加上一些自己的结论。

en.t: and, to save the time of systematically organizing my own views, I planned simply to list ready-made material from books and add a few conclusions of my own where appropriate.

units.source_text: 我选择的论文题目跟先生的研究很接近，就这个选题我曾征求过先生的意见。

en.t: The thesis topic I chose was very close to Sensei's field of study, and I had once asked him for his opinion about that choice.
At the time, Sensei said that it would probably be all right.

units.source_text: 急于完成论文的我，赶忙跑到先生家，请教应该看什么参考书。

en.t: Anxious to finish my thesis, I hurried to Sensei's house and asked what reference books I should read.

units.source_text: 先生很痛快地把自己所知道的知识都告诉了我，

en.t: Sensei readily told me everything he knew,

units.source_text: 还说可以借给我两三本必要的书籍，

en.t: and also said he could lend me two or three necessary books,

units.source_text: 但是先生丝毫不打算指导我的论文。

en.t: but Sensei had not the slightest intention of guiding my thesis.

units.source_text: “近来我不大看书了，不了解新的知识。

en.t: "Lately I have not been reading much, so I do not know the newer scholarship.

units.source_text: 你最好去问学校的先生。”

en.t: You had better ask one of your teachers at the university."
